title: Walkthrough: What This Lean 4 Repo Shows

canonical_node.axiom: Formal definitions in Lean 4 determine structural consequences; a zero channel collapses the product; restoration requires openness, input, cost, and memory; coherence requires the right kind of order, not mere control.
definitions: chi = G * M * E * S * T * K * R * Q * F * C (multiplicative product)
Full coherence: requires the right kind of order, not mere control
Passive entropy: not the same as active, chosen, relational discoherence
Restoration: requires open boundary, external input, paid repair cost, information/memory preservation
Fracture: structured mismatch: global coherence plus local rupture plus scar signature
Fall: structural spine with defined conditions; separation alone is not the Fall
Signature: factor has domain, mechanism, tendency
Fruit/anti-Fruit: lived output of a claim
derivation: Lean checks that if any effective channel is zero, the full product collapses.
Lean proves states C0 and C1 are distinct and transition is one-way.
Lean rejects label swaps by checking signatures.
Lean checks that coercive order is not full coherence.
Lean checks that passive entropy is not active evil.
Lean checks that restoration requires openness, input, cost, and memory.
Lean checks that a random gap is not a structured fracture.
Lean checks that separation alone is not the Fall.
Lean checks that high-signal deception is rejected.
Lean checks that inadequate substitutes for Trinity structure are rejected.
Lean checks that justice/mercy failure modes are rejected.
Lean checks that memory/identity requirements are enforced.
canonical_node.action: The system should use Lean 4 to verify formal definitions and reject false positives, label swaps, coercion, hidden denominators, and malformed structural claims.
boundary: Does not prove Christianity, Trinity, historical resurrection, moral theology, physics, or metaphysics in full real-world content.
Does not prove the Trinity from Maxwell's equations.
Does not prove grace as a person.
Chi evaluator is not a truth oracle.
Empirical and historical claims require evidence, interpretation, and public review.
test: Run `lake build`; success means Lean accepted definitions and proofs.
Adversarial file compiles including intentional rejection checks.
Check that zero channel collapses chi.
Check that coercive order is rejected as full coherence.
Check that passive entropy is not active evil.
Check that restoration requires openness, input, cost, memory.
Check that random gap is not fracture.
Check that separation alone is not Fall.
Check that high-signal deception is rejected.
Check that modalism, static single-field, arbitrary three-part are rejected.
Check that 8/10 is not reported as 90%.

dg1_dependencies: Formal definitions of chi structure, coupling states, signatures, coherence, restoration, fracture, fall, evaluator, justice/mercy, memory, hit-rate
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a formal, checkable framework that rejects false positives and malformed structural claims in theological/physics analogies.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to reason about structural consequences from definitions without claiming full real-world verification.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without the formal definitions and Lean checks, the project reduces to an informal essay with no teeth.
dg5_translation_registers: Theological: coherence, fall, grace, justice, mercy, restoration
Mathematical: product collapse, signatures, structural gates

classification.recommended_atom_action: preserve as formal structural framework; do not extend to real-world claims without additional evidence

overstatement_risks: Interpreting formal rejection of inadequate substitutes as proof of the real theological structure.
Treating the chi evaluator as a truth oracle.
Assuming Lean verifies the definitions capture reality.
Overgeneralizing from formal model to empirical/historical claims.
kill_conditions: If Lean build fails, the formal claims are not verified.
If definitions are changed, the verified consequences may no longer hold.
If the adversarial file does not compile, the rejection checks are not verified.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the structural gates and rejection checks in Lean 4, ensuring the build succeeds and the adversarial file compiles.

plain_summary: This document explains a Lean 4 repository that formalizes structural claims about coherence, restoration, fracture, fall, and related concepts. It emphasizes that Lean verifies formal consequences from definitions, not real-world truth. The repo includes positive theorems and an adversarial file that rejects false positives. The key idea is that a zero channel collapses the product, and restoration requires openness, input, cost, and memory. The document clearly states boundaries: it does not prove theology or physics, but only checks formal structure.
